speedupSummary: Ticker quote + valuation metrics lookup: 8,050 ms+ -> 702 ms (11.5x faster via domcontentloaded + top-frame + header menu compaction)
notes: Yahoo Finance streams live quotes and 20+ ad iframes that hang window.onload; Browser Bridge uses domcontentloaded + snapshotFrames=top (~700 ms vs 8s-30s).
Use "lookup_quote" (e.g. ticker='MSFT') or "read_quote_summary" to read <main> quote price and valuation stats directly.

lookup_quote.name: lookup_quote
lookup_quote.description: Jumps directly to finance.yahoo.com/quote/<ticker>/ with domcontentloaded and extracts <main> quote & key statistics.

ticker.description: Stock/ETF ticker symbol, e.g. MSFT, NVDA, AAPL.

read_quote_summary.name: read_quote_summary
read_quote_summary.description: Extracts current quote price, chart summary, and valuation metrics from <main> without Yahoo header nav clutter.
